# Warnet Nusantara.Net

> A free, open-source web recreation of an early-2000s Indonesian internet cafe (warnet): billing lock screen with dolphins, XP-style desktop, Wayback Machine time-travel browser, Winamp (Webamp), mIRC-style chat bots, Messenger with BUZZ, and legal retro games. Indonesian UI. No account, no install.

- Play: https://warnet-nusantara.pages.dev/
- 60-second flashback demo: https://warnet-nusantara.pages.dev/?demo
- Source code (AGPL-3.0-only; content CC BY-NC-SA 4.0): https://github.com/kelvindesman/warnet-nusantara

## Pages

- [Beranda (Indonesian)](https://warnet-nusantara.pages.dev/id/)
- [Home (English)](https://warnet-nusantara.pages.dev/en/)
- [Game Warnet](https://warnet-nusantara.pages.dev/game-warnet/): 46 legal games playable in the browser, 18 memorials for online games that are still owned by their publishers
- [Winamp](https://warnet-nusantara.pages.dev/winamp/)
- [mIRC](https://warnet-nusantara.pages.dev/mirc/)
- [Mesin waktu internet](https://warnet-nusantara.pages.dev/mesin-waktu-internet/): Indonesian websites from 1998–2015 through the Wayback Machine
- [Tentang warnet](https://warnet-nusantara.pages.dev/tentang-warnet/): FAQ about Indonesian internet cafes in the 2000s
